rules: All filters clamp values within defined ranges using machine codes from error envelope; interpolations use linear scaling with unitless inputs treated as defects; normalization applies consistent string trimming and case conversion per event kind; each rule is parameterized and justified by its source endpoint or facade trait.
invariants: Output must satisfy all schema constraints including required fields, type boundaries, and unit labeling; validation occurs at output stage using stored facade trait checks; any invariant failure triggers an immediate error with the failing field and check location in the storage facade trait.
